areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: More efficient systems cut energy use; driverless automation optimizes acceleration and braking, lowering consumption and emissions.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Driverless system improves service supply: higher capacity and frequency, shorter waits, greater safety and reliability.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Delivered under a public-private partnership contract; most financing is public (about 80%) and the concessionaire funds the rest, recovered via contractual rebalancing.

areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Modal shift benefits claimed, but the project covers only systems and has no actions directly promoting environmental sustainability.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Sanitation works are only relocation of utility interferences, not actions to implement or expand sanitation.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Water capture and groundwater use claimed, but no actions directly related to water security.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Partnerships cited by proponent, but no actions directly related to biodiversity or forest management.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Concession design and ancillary revenue cited, but no actions directly improving the business environment.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Commercial areas and station-surroundings effects cited, but no actions directly benefiting small businesses.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Job creation and better periphery-centre links cited, but no actions directly generating jobs and income.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Bus-metro integration offers accessible transport, but project is not directly aimed at low-income or vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Diversity actions belong to the concessionaire and are not part of this request.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Equity and women's safety measures cited, but no actions directly related to youth, gender or race policies.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Improved access to health system cited, but no actions directly tied to education or health.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Automation systems cited, but not considered directly related to technological development.
